_meta.description: Historical Documentary Production Pipeline — n8n Workflow Skeleton
_meta.notes: Import into n8n and configure credentials for each service. Each module runs independently with human approval gates between them.

module_1_script_generation.name: Documentary Script Generation

nodes.notes: Runs daily; switch to manual trigger for on-demand use
Replace with your preferred trending source (Google Trends, Reddit API, etc.)
Uses Claude to evaluate and rank topic ideas

parameters.prompt:
Create a 3-act narrative script for a 20-minute historical documentary on: {{$json.top_topic}}

- Act I: Hook (100 words), Setup (150 words)
- Act II: Rising Action with 4 retention hooks every 2-3 minutes (600 words)
- Act III: Climax & Legacy (200 words)
- Include 8-10 specific scenes with visual descriptions for AI image generation
- Add dry humor in narrator commentary
- Mark mid-roll ad breaks at natural chapter ends (around 8:00, 14:00, 18:00)
- For each scene, describe: setting, characters present, action, lighting/mood

Output as structured markdown matching the script template.

nodes.notes: Generates full documentary script with scene breakdowns
Logs script to Google Sheet for human review

module_1_script_generation.human_gate: Review and approve script in Google Sheet before triggering Module 2

module_2_asset_generation.name: Image & Video Asset Generation

nodes.notes: Triggered after human approves script

parameters.prompt:
Parse this documentary script into a structured JSON array of scenes. For each scene return:
- scene_id (e.g., 'scene_trojan_walls_01')
- scene_name
- character_ids (array of characters present)
- image_prompts (array of 3-4 Nano Banana Pro prompts, photorealistic/cinematic style, 4K)
- video_prompts (array of camera motion prompts for Runway/Veo)
- duration_seconds
- act (1, 2, or 3)

Script:
{{$json.approved_script}}

nodes.notes: AI extracts structured scene data from approved script
Calls Nano Banana Pro API for character reference sheets. Loop over each character.
Loop: generates 3-4 images per scene via Nano Banana Pro
Saves generated images to organized Google Drive folder
Converts each image to 4-sec video clip. Use Veo for characters, Runway for battles.
Saves video clips to organized folder
Tracks generation costs per episode

module_2_asset_generation.human_gate: Review all images and video clips before triggering Module 3

module_3_assembly.name: Timeline Assembly & Draft Upload

nodes.notes: Triggered after human approves all assets

parameters.prompt:
Generate an FFmpeg concat/filter_complex command to assemble these video clips into a documentary timeline.

Scene list with clip paths and durations:
{{$json.scene_manifest}}

Requirements:
- Arrange clips in act order (Act I, II, III)
- Hard cuts between clips (no dissolves)
- Add 0.5s fade-to-black at chapter breaks
- Leave audio track open for narration overlay
- Output as 1920x1080 MP4, H.264, high quality
- Include chapter markers in metadata

nodes.notes: AI generates the FFmpeg assembly command from scene manifest
Runs FFmpeg locally or on cloud VM to assemble rough cut

parameters.notes: Run Whisper on narration audio to generate closed captions (.srt)

nodes.notes: Generates subtitles from narration track via Whisper API

parameters.title: DRAFT - {{$json.episode_title}}
parameters.description: Draft for review — do not publish

nodes.notes: Uploads assembled video to YouTube as unlisted draft
Updates tracking sheet with draft URL for human review

module_3_assembly.human_gate: Watch unlisted draft, approve or request revisions before publishing

module_4_publishing.name: Publishing & Analytics Tracking

nodes.notes: Triggered after human approves final cut
AI generates optimized title, description, and tags
Moves video from unlisted to public (or schedules for optimal time: 2-3 PM ET)

parameters.notes: POST to Twitter/X API and Reddit API with teaser thumbnail and link

nodes.notes: Cross-posts to social media (configure per platform)
Logs publish event for later performance tracking
Checks YouTube Analytics API at 24hr, 7-day, 30-day marks and logs to sheet

module_4_publishing.human_gate: None after publish — automated tracking only
